_comment: Curated names for the 00-area parameters, consumed by sysex_param_table_tex.py.
confidence ESTABLISHED = the instrument or its published manual names this byte;
LIKELY = a hard match on value range or bit count, printed with a dagger;
anything weaker is left out of this file entirely rather than printed hedged.
basis must say what would have to be false for the name to be wrong.

20/03.name: VOL (LVL)
20/03.basis: mixer strip, caption over the value cell that reads this byte

20/04.name: EFF1
20/04.basis: mixer strip, caption over the value cell that reads this byte

20/05.name: EFF2
20/05.basis: mixer strip, caption over the value cell that reads this byte

20/06.name: REV
20/06.basis: mixer strip, caption over the value cell that reads this byte

20/07.name: PAN
20/07.basis: mixer strip; shown L64 to R63, 128 positions

20/40.name: INT (internal sound)
20/40.basis: mixer strip INT cell reads this bit

20/41.name: MIDI channel
20/41.basis: mixer strip MIDI cell; shown 1-01 to 2-16, and the manual gives the same 32 values

10/00.name: OCT
10/00.basis: mixer strip OCT cell reads this byte; shown -3 to +3

10/11.name: scale tuning type
10/11.basis: the scale-tuning routine tests this byte; 15 enumerated values, 0x80 = USER

10/13.name: user scale, note 1
10/13.basis: twelve consecutive bytes the user-scale routine reads
